title: P11: separate Q, K and V Muon updates
description: P11: orthogonalize each Q, K and V gradient matrix separately during Muon pretraining instead of jointly orthogonalizing the concatenated projection. Decoupling retrieval roles may improve the starting policy for fixed downstream expert iteration.
hypothesis: Incumbent 030 Muon improved all three downstream seeds and reached exact mean 212.67, whereas block sharing, normalization changes and EMA handoff failed against the older AdamW incumbent. No prior registration tests separate Q/K/V updates. Separate normalization and orthogonalization may prevent one attention role from suppressing useful directions in another, improving proof discovery during fixed RL. This remains an unverified mechanism. The unchanged Muon shape-scaling rule now applies to three square matrices (factor 1) instead of one tall matrix (factor sqrt(3)); the change therefore includes the scaling naturally induced by splitting, not a pure coupling isolation. Only the downstream three-seed metric decides keep/discard.
expected_delta: Central prediction +3 to +15 dev-transfer solves at true length >=7 versus incumbent 030 exact mean 212.67 (stored rounded mean 213), with plausible downside -80. Three square Newton-Schulz updates replace each tall QKV update, batched in one tensor; expect pretraining throughput within roughly 10% of incumbent 2905-2910 steps under the same 300-second cap. Model inference operations are unchanged, although learned generation lengths can change total runtime within the fixed 1200-second cap.

optimizer.name: muon hidden matrices + adamw auxiliary

muon.precision: bf16 Newton-Schulz; fp32 momentum and parameters
muon.shape_scale: sqrt(max(1, rows/columns)) per orthogonalized matrix: Q/K/V each 1, attention output 1, fc1 2, fc2 1
muon.schedule: same warmup/cosine fraction as AdamW; muon_lr = 0.02 * adam_lr / 0.001
muon.parameters: All 16 hidden projection parameters remain in Muon. Four qkv.weight matrices of shape (768,256) use independent Q/K/V updates, represented as a batch of three (256,256) matrices; proj/fc1/fc2 remain unchanged.
muon.license: MIT; full copyright and permission notice retained in pretrain.py
muon.qkv_split: After elementwise Nesterov momentum, reshape each QKV update to (3,256,256); independently Frobenius-normalize and run five batched Newton-Schulz steps; reshape back before applying. No extra learning-rate multiplier. Momentum and weight decay stay elementwise and unchanged.

optimizer.adamw_parameters: emb.weight, head.weight, all projection biases, all LayerNorm scales and offsets
optimizer.decay_convention: Muon wd=0.005 makes muon_lr*muon_wd equal incumbent adam_lr*0.1 at each schedule fraction; auxiliary wd=0.1 unchanged. Integrated decay can differ because throughput changes.
optimizer.clipping: joint global gradient norm 1.0 before both optimizers
optimizer.handoff: standard GPT and weights only; Muon buffers and optimizers are local to pretrain and are not handed to frozen RL
